content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

When you use Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy, you're renting infrastructure, relying on their payment processing, and storing customer data on their servers. The moment you get restricted or banned, your store goes dark, and you're left with no option but to start over. With COREMERCH, you own your infrastructure from day one, with full access to your data, payment processing, and customer relationships. You're not renting; you're building on top of a sovereign architecture that gives you the freedom to trade with anyone, anytime, anywhere.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The 'no service' approach taken by Stripe, PayPal, and their ilk is not a solution. They're simply not available in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and Bangladesh, leaving creators without a payment gateway. COREMERCH, on the other hand, has been built specifically for these regions, with a product like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deployed in 48 hours, giving creators a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. No more getting locked out due to a random flag or a sudden payment processing halt.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When you rely on Stripe or PayPal, you're hit with surprise fees, delayed payments, and a lack of transparency. COREMERCH takes a different approach, with a flat 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and no hidden costs. You get to choose your own payment network, with recommended options like BSC, Solana, or TRON offering fees under $0.10 per transaction. That's a real cost savings, especially for creators with high-volume sales.
You own your infrastructure, your data, and your customer relationships with COREMERCH.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With COREMERCH, you own your data, your payment processing, and your customer relationships. You're not relying on a third-party infrastructure to store your products, process payments, or deliver orders. You're in control, with full automation and integration capabilities. No more worrying about lost sales, delayed orders, or compromised customer data. Your customers get instant access to their purchases, and you get real-time insights into your sales performance.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing a solution, consider your specific needs and constraints. If you're in a restricted country, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a great starting point. If you're looking for a more basic setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) might be the way to go. Whatever your choice, remember that COREMERCH is not just a 'workaround' for restricted countries, but a permanent replacement for Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy. You're building on a sovereign architecture that's designed to last.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The most important question on your mind is probably: how do I get access to my money if PayPal suspends my account? The answer is simple: with COREMERCH, you own your funds, your data, and your customer relationships. You're not reliant on a third-party infrastructure to store your money or process payments. With full ownership and automation, you get to keep your hard-earned cash, no matter what happens.
Automate your payment processing, delivery, and customer management with COREMERCH.

Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with COREMERCH, follow these steps: Create a new GitHub Pages site for your online store. Set up Cloudflare Pages for automatic SSL certificates and Edge caching. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Load your products and set up delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for your domain. Test your setup thoroughly before going live. And that's it - you're now up and running with a fully operational online store that's not reliant on Stripe, PayPal, or their ilk.
